observations.sql:
SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM questions q
LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = q.subject_id
WHERE (s.is_locked = false OR s.is_locked IS NULL)

SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM questions q
LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = q.subject_id
WHERE (s.is_locked = false OR s.is_locked IS NULL)
AND s.id IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM questions q
LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = q.subject_id
WHERE (s.is_locked = false OR s.is_locked IS NULL)
AND s.id IS NOT NULL
AND s.id <> ALL(CAST(:excluded_subject_ids AS integer[]))

SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM questions q
LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = q.subject_id
WHERE (s.is_locked = false OR s.is_locked IS NULL)
AND s.id IS NOT NULL
AND s.name = :subject_name
AND q.type = :question_type

SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM questions q
LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = q.subject_id
WHERE (s.is_locked = false OR s.is_locked IS NULL)
AND q.id = ANY(CAST(:candidate_question_ids AS bigint[]))

SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM questions q
LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = q.subject_id
WHERE (s.is_locked = false OR s.is_locked IS NULL)
AND q.id = ANY(CAST(:candidate_question_ids AS bigint[]))

SELECT COUNT(1)
FROM questions q
LEFT JOIN subjects s ON s.id = q.subject_id
WHERE (s.is_locked = false OR s.is_locked IS NULL)
AND q.id = ANY(CAST(:candidate_question_ids AS bigint[]))
